urdu: 1958ء کے مارشل لا کے بعد پہلا 23 مارچ کس نئے نام سے منایا گیا؟
english: What new name was given to the first March 23rd after the 1958 martial law?
roman_1: 1958 ke martial law ke baad pehla 23 March kis naye naam se manaya gaya?
roman_2: 1958 k martial law k baad pehla 23 March kis naye naam se manaya gaya?
roman_3: 1958 me marshal law ke baad pehla 23 March kis naye naam se manaya gaya?
